profile.summary: A nonprofit that runs a paid summer fellowship for professionals from many backgrounds who want to help improve communities through people and partnerships. Fellows split their time between policy work and placements with partner organizations. It is registered as a tax-exempt 501(c)(3) in Colorado Springs, Colorado.
